parsed.why: No same-sex or cross-dressing offence; 2018 sexual-orientation equality signal. But no trans-specific protection, old societal stigma, thin record; missing LGR is resident gap, not visitor exposure.

Enforced cross-dressing offence, morality police, documents cannot align, no assurance for foreigners; same-sex penalties include stoning under revocable moratorium. Direct state targeting of gender expression.
Decriminalised 2023; Pride with police protection, growing acceptance, welcoming resorts. Trans progress limited, no LGR/GI protection, but no active traveller-facing trans restriction documented.
Unequal age of consent and marriage-nullity rule create legal exposure; 2025 rejection of anti-LGBT violence/hate-speech measures, social concealment, old trans-violence record show thin recourse.

Never criminalised, equal age of consent, state tolerance and visible trans cultural presence. No anti-discrimination law, blocked LGBTI webpages and public-immodesty caution keep it a reduced-risk but not protective tier.
